content:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: smart-routing fallback oscillation affecting eu-west customers. Surge of 5xx and increased latency since config deploy at ~10:12 UTC. Auto-escalating to on-call.

oncall-ryan: I’m on it. Paging SRE.

sre-maria: I’m looking at the routing logs now. Seeing repeated cross-region failovers between eu-west and eu-central for model-variant tx-small. Looks like requests keep bouncing until they hit a variant mismatch and 5xx.

platform-dan: Any recent deploys to routing-policy service?

eng-rija: We rolled the policy schema v2 change 10:11 UTC that deprecated `prefer_failover_region` and introduced `fallback_mode`. Default for `fallback_mode` was unintentionally set to `round_robin` in the migration script.

incidents-bot: Alert details: 2400 requests with 500/502 in the last 6m, p95 latency up 3x. Impact: some hosted API customers in eu-west reporting errors and degraded streaming.

cs-oliver: Heads up — we have a few paying customers reporting errors via Support. I'll prepare a short customer-facing note once we have root cause.

oncall-ryan: Copy. Maria, can you confirm traffic pattern? Is it a config-only issue or runtime bug?

sre-maria: Looks config-only. Router is honoring `fallback_mode: round_robin` and cycling across regions, but some regions do not host `tx-small-v2` (model variant mismatch), so requests hit incompatible backends and fail.

eng-rija: Here's the problematic snippet from the migration commit:```yaml
# routing-policy v2 migration snippet
- name: default_failover
  fallback_mode: round_robin  # accidentally set as default
  prefer_failover_region: null  # deprecated field removed
```

platform-dan: Oof. The old behavior when `prefer_failover_region` was present was to prefer same-region then single fallback. round_robin makes it oscillate.

oncall-ryan: Mitigation plan: 1) Freeze policy-migration rollouts. 2) Set fallback_mode to `prefer_local_then_single` globally. 3) Pin model-variant compatibility check to avoid routing to incompatible variants. Who can push the quick config?

eng-rija: I can push a hotfix to the control plane to set `fallback_mode` to `prefer_local_then_single` and re-enable the legacy behavior quickly. Will open a change.

deploy-bot: CI job started: patch/policy-v2-hotfix — build #4582

platform-dan: Also propose temporarily disabling cross-region failover for tx-* variants to stop oscillation. Command:```bash
# admin API
curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/policies/global/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"fallback_mode":"prefer_local_then_single","cross_region_failover":false}'
```

sre-maria: Executed override via admin API and verified policy updated. Router config reload picked up new setting. Monitoring now.

oncall-ryan: Thanks — rolling metrics now. Any customer-facing impact estimate?

cs-oliver: Based on Support pings, about 6 customers hit errors in the last 20m; 2 of them are on committed Dedicated plans. I'll escalate to CSM triage.

incidents-bot: Status update: error rate dropping from 18% -> 3% over 5m after override. p95 latency returning toward baseline.

eng-rija: Follow-up: we should add a compatibility check in the routing decision that verifies the target region actually has the model variant. Quick patch: if variant not present, mark as NOT_ELIGIBLE instead of attempting failover. I'll open PR.

platform-dan: Good. Also need to revert the migration script default so new tenants don’t get round_robin. Put a migration rollback task in the release board.

sre-maria: Monitoring shows no oscillation now. Will keep on-call until stable for 60m.

oncall-ryan: Handoff: I’ll stay for the next 30m then pass to day SRE. Maria to continue watch. Rija, please link the hotfix PR and runbook.

eng-rija: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/policies/pull/743 — includes compatibility check and migration default fix. Runbook: https://wiki/internal/incidents/fallback-oscillation (added mitigation steps and commands).

cs-oliver: Drafted customer note and posted to the incident channel — will wait for final confirmation before emailing.

incidents-bot: Incident severity lowered to P2. Keep thread updated.

sre-maria: Final check: no new 5xx spikes for 18m, p95 latency stable. I’m going to close paging at +45m if stable.

oncall-ryan: Thanks team. Post-incident items: 1) add unit/integration test for routing compatibility, 2) change migration script default, 3) add alert to catch sudden increase in cross-region failovers. Assigning owners in the runbook.

eng-rija: Will take migration script fix and PR.

platform-dan: I’ll add the alert rule and playbook snippet.

cs-oliver: I’ll follow up with customers and provide a post-mortem summary for support.

incidents-bot: Incident resolved: fallback oscillation mitigated and control plane hotfix deployed. Postmortem to be scheduled. :white_check_mark:
